title: page-lab/block@1
description: One navigation the gate STOPPED on, recorded so a human can hand off and a resume can continue. The producer is scripts/lib/envelope.mjs (buildBlock) and nothing else; the writer is scripts/page-lab-gate.mjs, which appends one per stop to the run's events.jsonl and exits 10. A sibling of page-lab/pick@1, not a widening of it: pick@1 is never widened in place, and its process outcomes exit WITHOUT an envelope.
$comment: Same keyword surface as pick-envelope.schema.json, so lib/envelope.mjs#validate enforces it with zero new validator code: type, properties, required, additionalProperties, items, enum, const, pattern, minLength, maxLength, minimum, maximum, allOf, if/then. Deliberately no $ref/$defs. No field carries page markup or a cookie: evidence names the RULE that matched (a slug, pattern-checked) plus what the detectors READ — status, three allowlisted headers, a capped and redacted title — and additionalProperties:false makes that a rule rather than a wish. ONE deviation from the design doc's enum (docs/page-lab-vnext-design.md §7.4): reason also admits detector-error. §7.1 says exit 10 always writes an event, §7.3 says an unparseable probe or an unreadable status STOPS; without a reason for that stop the two cannot both hold, and an exit 10 with no event would leave resume and handoff with no record of why the run stopped.

schema.description: Schema identity AND version. A future shape is page-lab/block@2 with its own file; this one is never widened in place.

measuredAt.description: Local date of the stop — the same vocabulary and format as pick@1. Timestamps for the 24 h cooldown window live in the run's cooldown.json, not here.

url.description: The queue item's URL — what the gate was asked to open, not where the browser ended up (a final URL can carry a login redirect's tokens).

origin.description: Origin of url, derived by the producer. The unit the cooldown counts in.

reason.description: Why the gate stopped. detector-error = a detector could not read its signal (the probe's JSON did not parse, no main-document request was listed, the CLI call failed). It STOPS like any other reason: a detector that cannot see fails closed, never open.

detector.description: Which of the fixed detectors in references/gate-detectors.json fired.

rule.description: The matched rule's NAME from references/gate-detectors.json — a slug, so it cannot carry a title, a selector's match or any page text.

status.description: The main document's HTTP status, read from list_network_requests --resourceTypes document (the request at the final URL), never from navigate_page's success text (which reads "Successfully navigated" on a 403). Present whenever it was read; required on an http-* reason; absent on status-unreadable.

headers.description: The ALLOWLISTED response headers of the main document, as read after --redactNetworkHeaders (cf-* values arrive as "<redacted>"; their presence is the signal). additionalProperties:false is the rule that keeps set-cookie and every other header out.

title.description: The page title as read, capped at 120 characters with token-like runs replaced by [redacted] (lib/gate.mjs#safeTitle). The only page-derived text an event carries.

profile.description: The page-lab/profile@1 name the run drove.

queuePos.description: Zero-based line of the item in the run's queue.jsonl.

notes.description: Limitations in the operator's words. Never page text.

allOf.$comment: An http-* reason is a status stop, only a status stop, and carries the status it stopped on.
